subject: Request: semi-annual invoicing + Net-60 with early-pay incentive
messages:
From: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@equestracorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing cadence request — semi-annual invoices + Net-60

Hi Karthik,

Quick follow-up from our procurement team — Equestra runs semi-annual budgeting for our platform spend and would prefer two invoices per year to align with our audit cycles. The ask is: 6-month invoicing (two invoices per year) with Net-60 payment terms.

We can offer a small incentive: 2% discount if payment received within 30 days of invoice. Current procurement policy requires finance to sign off, but they asked me to check if Redwood is able to accommodate this cadence and the Net-60 window.

Attached is the latest SOW draft (Equestra_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short vendor questionnaire from our finance team. We are targeting a PO the week of Oct 18, but approval of terms would speed that up.

Are these billing terms something Redwood can consider for strategic pilot customers? If not, what flexibility do you have on a compromise (e.g., Net-60 but 1.5% early-pay instead of 2%)?

Thanks,
Sarah Wong
Head of Procurement, Equestra
finance@equestra.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Billing cadence request — semi-annual invoices + Net-60

Team — forwarding request from Equestra (deal DEAL-8432). Key facts: ARR impact ~ $420k first year, strategic pilot in healthcare vertical, procurement wants semi-annual invoices + Net-60 with a proposed 2% early-pay incentive.

Why I need quick exec input: standard Redwood T&Cs are monthly invoicing + Net-30. This is non-standard payment cadence and extended terms; Finance will flag DSO and cashflow. Negotiation levers we can offer: smaller early-pay %, initial deposit, or conditional approval with credit guardrails.

Proposed by sales (my POV): agree to semi-annual invoices + Net-60 if Equestra signs a 12-month commitment and we secure one of the following: (a) 1x advance equal to the first semi-annual invoice, or (b) 1.5% early-pay incentive instead of 2%, with RHS (Rev Ops) review.

Attachments: Equestra_SOW_v1.pdf (from customer), completed credit checklist (Equestra_credit_form.pdf).

Can we get an approval cadence here? Laura, can Rev Ops/Finance approve on the condition above? Lauren / Aditya — any product/CS escalations we should consider operationally for semi-annual billing?

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing cadence request — semi-annual invoices + Net-60

Karthik — thanks for the clear write-up. Reviewed with Finance and Revenue Ops this morning. Given the deal size and strategic fit, I am willing to approve a conditional exception with the following guardrails: 

1) Billing cadence: semi-annual invoices for the first 12 months only (pilot period).
2) Payment terms: Net-60 accepted for customer invoices.
3) Early-pay incentive: capped at 1.5% for payment within 30 days (Finance counter-offer to their 2%).
4) Commercial safeguards: require either (a) advance equal to the first semi-annual invoice or (b) a signed lockbox arrangement + completed credit check with no material adverse findings.
5) Contract amendment: Sales to add addendum language to SOW specifying the pilot billing cadence and early-pay matrix; Legal to review minor redline.
6) Finance point of contact: Aditya Rao will own the operational setup and ensure AR and collections workflows are documented.

This exception is time-boxed — review after 12 months; if we see elevated DSO or churn risk, we will revert to standard monthly billing.

Karthik — you have my conditional sign-off. Please confirm which commercial safeguard the customer prefers and route the SOW amendment to Legal + Finance.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@equestracorp.com>, finance@equestra.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 20:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing cadence request — semi-annual invoices + Net-60

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear ask. We can accommodate the semi-annual billing cadence for a 12-month pilot with the following agreed terms (Rev Ops/Finance has provided conditional approval):

- Invoicing cadence: two invoices per 12-month term (semi-annual) for the pilot year only.
- Payment terms: Net-60.
- Early-pay discount: 1.5% if payment received within 30 days (Redwood counter to your 2% ask).
- Safeguard: customer to choose one of the following: (A) advance payment equal to first semi-annual invoice; OR (B) sign the lockbox arrangement + complete the credit check (no material adverse findings).
- Next steps: I will update the SOW to include an addendum documenting the billing cadence and early-pay details and send for DocuSign. Legal will do a quick redline review; Aditya will lead AR setup.

If this sounds acceptable, can you confirm which safeguard you prefer (advance or lockbox + credit), and we'll route the SOW amendment for signatures. Targeting DocuSign by end of next week to keep the PO timeline on track.

Attachments: Equestra_SOW_v1.pdf (updated to show pilot language will be included)
DocuSign link (to follow once we choose safeguard).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
